learning_outcomes.text: Explain periodicity and the chemistry of the main-group elements
Apply crystal-field ideas to colour and magnetism
Explain solid-state structures and bonding models
Interpret descriptive chemistry of representative compounds
Describe how AI accelerates inorganic materials discovery
